program.title: BSc in Mathematics and Economics
uncertain: The 'Required Course(s)' group contains multiple sub-notes (e.g., for MATH 2033/2043, MATH 2121/2131, etc.). The schema only allows one 'note' per group. I have placed the first complex note in the group note field. The other notes are implicit in the course listings or lost in the single-note constraint. Human review is needed to decide if these should be split into separate groups or if the note field should concatenate them.
The 'ECON 4000-level or above Electives' group lists no specific courses in the PDF, only a requirement description. I have included it as a group with an empty courses list.
The 'Science Foundation course' elective list continues from Page 2 to Page 3. I have combined them into one group.

total_required_credits (24.0) is a computed value: the sum of the required_credits of all groups in this file. The PDF does not state a single overall minimum total for this program, so this figure is derived by summation and may double-count where optional tracks/options are listed as separate groups.
